meta.analysis: D04 frozen fitted component decomposition on phase-zero OOF rows
meta.units: hourly net fraction change; multiply by 100 for percentage points
meta.weighting: original phase-zero county-event design weights conditional on each slice; all-regime is pooled
meta.county_type_role: D02 current-event-outcome-blind navigation partition, not six physical mechanisms
meta.transform_scope: the saved fold feature_map is applied without fitting; all bases are fold-training standardized
meta.operator_norm_unit: Euclidean/Frobenius norm of reconstructed coefficients times y_scale in fold-standardized coordinates
meta.block_total_rule: block predictions sum to each component; block RMS values do not sum to total RMS
meta.interpretation: correlated-basis fitted decomposition; not independent effects, physical contributions, causal effects, or unique order evidence
meta.nonidentifiability: low-rank factors and allocation across correlated inputs are not unique; norms use reconstructed coefficient operators
meta.uncertainty: no model-fitting or selection uncertainty estimated; between-fold differences are descriptive
